title: Transmission Electron Microscopy Specialist (1-Year Contract)
desc:
The Nanofabrication and Nanocharacterization Center for Science and Technological Advanced Research (n2STAR) at Koç University is seeking a highly motivated Electron Microscopy Specialist to oversee the operation, maintenance, and advanced analytical workflows of our aberration-corrected Hitachi HF-5000 S/TEM facility.
The successful candidate will support advanced electron microscopy research conducted by academic groups, graduate researchers, and industrial partners at Koç University and collaborating institutions with state-of-the-art structural, chemical, and atomic-scale characterization.
Qualifications & Competencies
Education
: Ph.D. degree in Materials Science & Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or a related science/engineering discipline.
Technical Expertise:
Hands-on experience in Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) and Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM).
Experience with aberration-corrected S/TEM and atomic-resolution imaging is highly desirable
Experience with STEM imaging modes such as HAADF-STEM, ADF-STEM, and BF/ABF-STEM and familiarity with electron-optical alignment, probe optimization, and aberration-corrector tuning.
Hands-on experience in sample preparation for TEM and HRTEM analysis and being familiar with the associated characterization modules (e.g., EDS, EELS, EBSD).
Strong understanding of electron diffraction, including selected-area electron diffraction (SAED), convergent-beam electron diffraction (CBED), and/or related diffraction techniques.
A proven scientific track record on the use of TEM and HRTEM characterization techniques (e.g., peer-reviewed publications, patents, or notable research contributions).
Personal Attributes & Drive:
Dedicated to research, driven by scientific curiosity, and eager to master cutting-edge characterization methodologies.
Highly self-motivated with strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
Willingness to adopt flexible working hours to meet research project deadlines and accommodate complex analysis schedules.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, researchers, and industrial partners.
Language Skills: Proficient in English (both written and spoken) for technical reporting, conducting training sessions, and international collaborations.
Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day operations, routine maintenance, calibration, and alignment of the S/TEM and HRTEM instruments within the n2Star research center.
Perform high-quality sample preparation, TEM/STEM imaging, diffraction, EDS, and EELS analyses for internal academic researchers and external industrial clients; deliver structured analysis reports.
Provide comprehensive technical training and operational guidance to graduate students and researchers.
Coordinate with instrument vendors and service engineers to ensure maximum instrument uptime, managing service contracts, troubleshooting, and consumables inventory.
